about: The deployed Phase 5 executor's startV2 gas on Base, simulated by eth_simulateV1 (nothing sent) over every cycle of the live universe after a whale moved one of its pools: 'sell' trades buy back WETH in the pool the whale sold into; 'buy' trades sell WETH where the whale bought it, so hop 2 climbs a pool nothing has touched this block. Each trade returned the book's predicted gross to the wei. Hops: [venue, zero_for_one, initialized ticks crossed, word steps], from the book's own quote.
